reference_sql:
SELECT promo_code, end_date - start_date + 1 AS days_running
FROM promotions
alternatives: SELECT promo_code, date_diff('day', start_date, end_date) + 1 AS days_running FROM promotions
SELECT promo_code, CAST(end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS DATE) - start_date AS days_running FROM promotions

other_way.sql: SELECT promo_code, date_diff('day', start_date, end_date) + 1 AS days_running FROM promotions
other_way.tradeoff: date_diff('day', start, end) + 1 gives the same count, but the plain minus is shorter and also works on dates in PostgreSQL.
